mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_api_usage_stat stat LEFT JOIN sys_user usr ON usr.id = stat.user_id WHERE stat.module_name = #{moduleName}
AND (usr.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR usr.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_api_usage_stat (user_id, module_name, api_path, use_count, last_access_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{moduleName}, #{apiPath}, #{useCount}, #{lastAccessTime}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, module_name) DO UPDATE SET api_path = EXCLUDED.api_path, use_count = sys_api_usage_stat.use_count + EXCLUDED.use_count, last_access_time = GREATEST(sys_api_usage_stat.last_access_time, EXCLUDED.last_access_time)
